econometric_drivers.title: PADD 1B Import Parity & Econometric Levers
econometric_drivers.description: Newark sits in the PADD 1B Central Atlantic pricing zone where retail pump prices track NY Harbor wholesale RBOB futures, waterborne import parity from Europe, and regional Atlantic spot margins.

refining_logistics.title: PBF Delaware City Refining & Maritime Logistics
refining_logistics.description: Located 12 miles south of Newark, DE, PBF's Delaware City Refinery processes 180,000 bpd of heavy sour crude delivered via Delaware Bay lightering at Big Stone Anchorage and C&D Canal barge routes.

tax_structure.title: Delaware State Fuel Tax & Statutory Overhead
tax_structure.description: Delaware state motor fuel tax ($0.230/gal) combined with US Federal excise tax ($0.184/gal) establishes a total statutory tax overhead of $0.414/gal across New Castle County stations.
tax_structure.notes: Maintained at flat statutory rate across New Castle County

infrastructure_delivery.title: Newark Delivery Hub & Dynamic Rack Margin
infrastructure_delivery.description: Calibrates predicted wholesale returns directly into local I-95 corridor pump station rack prices.
